# gesture-audio

> Gesture-gated Tone.js bus graph + Howler sprite resolver + preferences
> bridge for reliable browser audio. Treats Web Audio unlock and application
> bootstrap as one concurrent-safe, retryable transaction.

Install: `npm install @jbdevprimary/gesture-audio tone howler` (`tone` and
`howler` are peer dependencies).

## Read next

- [Full documentation](https://jonbogaty.com/gesture-audio/) — Astro
  Starlight site built from this repo's `docs-site/`. Its own
  `/llms.txt`, `/llms-small.txt`, and `/llms-full.txt` (generated by
  `starlight-llms-txt`) are the canonical machine-readable entry points and
  supersede this file for anything beyond orientation.
- [README.md](./README.md) — install, quick start, sprite map shape,
  preferences contract, public API table.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — repository layout, module responsibilities,
  workflows, and conventions for an agent working in this codebase.
- [docs/architecture.md](./docs/architecture.md) — invariants, lifecycle,
  error policy.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](./docs/troubleshooting.md) — common failures.

## Public API entry points

- `@jbdevprimary/gesture-audio` — the runtime import (browser-safe).
- `@jbdevprimary/gesture-audio/build-tools` — Node-only asset verification
  (`verifySprites`, `runVerifySpritesCli`); never imported from the runtime
  entry point.
